summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: @onereach/content-builder-template-compiler@0.0.4 declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, when no local `bun` binary is present, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a shipped `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with scrambled identifiers (e.g. `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `WV8StW`) and a rotated string/opcode array — canonical string-array obfuscation whose content is opaque and unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a template-literal compiler). The combination — auto-executing preinstall, purpose mismatch (a template compiler pulling a full alternate language runtime), and a heavily obfuscated sibling payload that runs under that runtime with no user interaction — is an alternate-runtime install-time execution pattern that runs opaque code on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
